messages.subject: NA/NaN argument
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I would like to run Maaslin on my computer. I installed it and the demo seems to run. At least, in the terminal, there are no complains. When I try R Studio it runs, but I get these warnings:

48: In is.na <http://is.na>(funcAnalysis) :

  is.na <http://is.na>() applied to non-(list or vector) of type 'closure'

49: In is.na <http://is.na>(funcGetResult) :

  is.na <http://is.na>() applied to non-(list or vector) of type 'closure'

50: In if (is.na <http://is.na>(lsOne)) { ... :

  the condition has length > 1 and only the first element will be used

When I try on my own data in the terminal, I get the following error:

Warning message:

package ‘gamlss’ was built under R version 3.3.2

Error in liItemElement[1]:liItemElement[2] : NA/NaN argument

Calls: Maaslin ... funcReadMatrices -> funcReadMatrix -> funcParseIndexSlices

Execution halted

Could you please tell me what might be wrong?

Thanks a lot! I can´t wait to get the program running and seeing the results!

Cheers,

Stefanie
